Claude Code — Complete Getting Started Guide (2026)

Claude Code is Anthropic's official command-line interface that brings Claude directly into your development environment. Instead of copy-pasting code into a browser window, Claude Code runs in your terminal with access to your actual project files — it can read your codebase, write and edit files, run shell commands, and navigate complex multi-file codebases without you lifting a finger. Getting started with Claude Code takes under five minutes if you have Node.js installed. This guide covers exactly that: installation, authentication, your first session, the most useful commands, and the patterns that make Claude Code dramatically more effective than using Claude in a chat interface for serious development work.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is Claude Code?
Claude Code is Anthropic's official command-line interface (CLI) for Claude. It runs in your terminal and gives Claude direct access to your local codebase — it can read files, write code, run commands, search for patterns, and make multi-file edits. It is designed for developers who want AI assistance inside their actual development environment rather than a browser chat window.
How do I install Claude Code?
Claude Code is installed via npm. Run 'npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code' in your terminal, then run 'claude' to launch it. You will need an Anthropic account and API key, or a Claude Pro or Max subscription. Full prerequisites and setup steps are covered in this guide.
Is Claude Code free to use?
Claude Code is available to Claude Pro and Max subscribers at no additional per-token cost within their plan limits. API users are billed for tokens consumed by Claude Code sessions. There is no separate charge for the CLI itself — you pay for the underlying Claude API usage.
